lines.speaker: Mr. Reyes
lines.text: Here. These are the official manuscript guidelines.

lines.speaker: Mr. Reyes
lines.text: Format the student demands as a numbered list and supporting arguments as bullet points.

lines.speaker: Mr. Reyes
lines.text: If your editorial is off by even a millimeter, don't bother bringing it back.

lines.speaker: Mr. Reyes
lines.text: Do not return until your editorial strictly follows the formatting guidelines and is reviewed by your adviser.

lines.speaker: Mr. Reyes
lines.text: The alignment is clean. The numbered demands and bulleted evidence are clear.

lines.speaker: Mr. Reyes
lines.text: I suppose I cannot reject a manuscript that follows publication style guides so... religiously.

lines.speaker: Mr. Reyes
lines.text: Don't bother me if you'll end up wasting my time...
